title: The host's key flows
description: The body of PUT /api/v1/flows (server secret): every key flow of the project, replacing the ones there (a flow left out is retired; its runs are kept). Defined in the host's code and pushed at deploy (mybeast:sessions-flows). Keep a flow's slug and its steps' keys: runs and stuck points name them; a new step at the end is safe.

give_up_after_hours.description: A run with no new step for this long has been given up (default 24).

new_account_days.description: A milestone flow (a first run): it starts at a new person's first step - their account at most this many days old (the steps' subject_since) - never twice. Its first step is a start step.

kind.description: Reached by a visit, or a save, of one of the routes; start: a milestone flow's first step, reached when its run starts (no routes).

routes.description: Route NAMES, as the steps carry them. A visit or save step names one at least; a start step none. Beyond the schema, the service also checks: a start step only first, and a flow begins with one exactly when it is a milestone flow (new_account_days).
